policy.title: MRI Lumbar Spine — ONE order type, internal OR

order_types.logic_expression: C1 AND (C2 OR (C3 AND C4)) AND C5
order_types._note: ONE order type: red-flag route (C2) OR failed-conservative route (C3+C4) share the same docs + exclusion, so they OR *inside* this order type — not a split.

criteria.title: Low back pain present
criteria.definition: The patient has documented low back pain.

criteria.title: Red-flag indication
criteria.definition: At least one red flag: neurologic deficit on exam, suspected cauda equina syndrome, or suspected spinal infection or malignancy.

criteria.title: Conservative therapy trial
criteria.definition: At least 6 weeks of conservative treatment completed without adequate relief.

criteria.title: Documentation recency
criteria.definition: Exam or conservative-treatment documentation dated within 6 months before the order.

criteria.title: MRI aneurysm-clip exclusion
criteria.definition: Not covered when the patient has metallic clips on vascular aneurysms.
